Beyond the terminal.

Engineering is more than compiling code or routing traces. It’s about people, energy, and community. Stepping out from behind the screen to mentor, connect, and lead.

SIT FYE HELIX · CIRRUS 15 (C15)
FIRST YEAR EXPERIENCE · FACILITATOR

Welcoming the Next Wave of SITizens

Serving as a Helix FYE Facilitator for sub-alliance Cirrus 15 (C15) was an experience centered on empathy, shared trust, and genuine human connection. Our mission went far beyond running icebreakers—it was about creating an inclusive space where incoming freshmen felt seen, supported, and confident navigating the transition into university life.

What made the event truly special was seeing our juniors courageously step out of their comfort zones to embrace every challenge, making the camp just as transformative and memorable for us facils as it was for them. Seeing them open up and form genuine, lasting bonds—to the point where we still stay closely in touch long after orientation ended—was the most rewarding proof that our three months of tireless preparation had truly paid off.

None of this would have been possible without the unwavering heart, relentless dedication, and close synergy of my fellow facilitators and the entire Cirrus alliance. Working shoulder-to-shoulder with such an inspiring team transformed late nights and demanding logistics into an unforgettable milestone that welcomed our newest SITizens home.
